news.headline: CF Industries to buy Mosaic's Louisiana ammonia plant in $600 million deal
news.quote: announced an agreement to acquire Mosaic's Faustina ammonia production plant in St. James, Louisiana, along with its storage and logistics infrastructure

touches.claim: CF Industries operates the world's largest ammonia production network, supported by an extensive North American storage, transportation, and distribution network.

CF Industries compounds nutrient production per share via capacity expansion and share repurchases, having increased production capacity 36% and decreased share count 58% since 2010 to reach 55 annual nitrogen equivalent tons per 1,000 shares outstanding as of September 30, 2026, with a 2030F target of 63.

Achieving the 2030F target of 63 annual nitrogen equivalent tons per 1,000 shares requires delivering CF's 40% share of Blue Point capacity on time at nameplate capacity, executing the ~$1.1B remaining under the $2B share repurchase program expiring December 2029, and sustaining ~60% average conversion of Adjusted EBITDA to free cash flow.

news.why: CF Industries agreed to buy Mosaic's Faustina ammonia plant and related storage and logistics assets in Louisiana for $600 million (including $360 million in cash), which expands its North American ammonia and logistics network and capacity growth while deploying capital alongside its Blue Point build and share repurchase program without disclosed asset capacity or earnings terms.

business_model.claim: CF Industries produces anhydrous ammonia using the Haber-Bosch process and sells ammonia directly or upgrades it into nitrogen fertilizer and industrial products.
quotes: We use the Haber-Bosch process to fix atmospheric nitrogen with hydrogen from natural gas to produce anhydrous ammonia, whose chemical composition is NH3.
We sell the ammonia itself or upgrade it to products such as granular urea, UAN and DEF.

business_model.claim: Upgraded products used primarily as nitrogen fertilizers are granular urea, UAN, and AN (also used in commercial explosives), while DEF, urea liquor, nitric acid, and aqua ammonia are sold primarily to industrial customers.
quotes: Products derived from ammonia that are most often used as nitrogen fertilizers include granular urea, urea ammonium nitrate solution (UAN) and ammonium nitrate (AN).
AN is also used extensively by the commercial explosives industry as a component of explosives.
Products derived from ammonia that are sold primarily to industrial customers include diesel exhaust fluid (DEF), urea liquor, nitric acid and aqua ammonia.

business_model.claim: Following the Donaldsonville decarbonization project, the company has capacity to produce up to approximately 1.9 million tons of low-carbon ammonia annually for traditional agriculture and emerging applications such as power generation, steel production in Japan, and marine shipping.
quotes: As a result of the Donaldsonville CCS project, we have the capacity to produce up to approximately 1.9 million tons of low-carbon ammonia annually at our Donaldsonville complex.

In addition, our low-carbon ammonia and upgraded products derived from low-carbon ammonia (“low-carbon upgraded products”, together with low-carbon ammonia “low-carbon products”) are expected to be used for existing and new applications, such as power generation and steel production in Japan, and to help customers reduce the economic impact of European carbon border adjustment fees and other carbon regulations.

New growth opportunities include power generation and marine shipping, which are hard-to-abate industries for which low-carbon ammonia offers a potential path to significantly lower carbon footprints as it does not contain or emit carbon when combusted.

business_model.claim: Principal customers are cooperatives, retailers, independent fertilizer distributors, traders, wholesalers, and industrial users, supplied from manufacturing complexes in the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom and a North American storage, transportation, and distribution network.
quotes: Our principal customers are cooperatives, retailers, independent fertilizer distributors, traders, wholesalers and industrial users.

Our value chain consists of manufacturing complexes in the United States, Canada and the United Kingdom, an extensive storage, transportation and distribution network in North America, and logistics capabilities enabling a global reach.

business_model.claim: Under a strategic venture supply agreement, minority partner CHS Inc. can purchase annually up to approximately 1.1 million tons of granular urea and 580,000 tons of UAN at market prices, while Blue Point One joint venture partners are required to purchase output in proportion to their ownership shares once production starts.
quotes: CHS also receives deliveries pursuant to a supply agreement under which CHS has the right to purchase annually from CFN up to approximately 1.1 million tons of granular urea and 580,000 tons of UAN at market prices.
